verdict.rationale: kitty's documented remote-control interface lets scripts open windows, send arbitrary text to any window, and change window and tab titles; tabs, splits and layouts are described as programmable. A hands-on probe confirmed a full external control loop: `kitten @ ls` returned window, tab and layout state as JSON, then send-text, get-text and close-window all worked. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or mapping showing remote control covers every UI and mappable action (true parity), and independent community corroboration of API completeness.
